walks.walk: Read each new test against the old code and say whether it would fail without the change.
walks.catches: A test that passes with or without the change proves nothing about it.

walks.walk: Follow the change down its unhappy path: bad input, an empty result, a failed call, a refused permission.
walks.catches: The happy path works and the first error a user meets crashes or says nothing.

walks.walk: Search the repository for every caller of what the change renamed, removed or changed, and check each still works.
walks.catches: A caller the change did not update still passes the old name or the old shape.

walks.walk: For every field the ticket gives a range or set, confirm a test feeds a value just outside it and expects its own refusal message
walks.catches: The daily list validator accepted ranks outside 1-10 or non-integer ranks, so a list with no rank 10 passed as valid
